messages:
leo t: Quick sync so we can finalize the pilot scope with BeaconHealth. Key items: sample payload format (CSV vs JSONL), redaction policy, connectivity option (VPC peering vs presigned upload), and measurable success criteria. Who owns which piece?

sam k: I can take sandbox infra. Preference: JSONL newline-delimited objects — easier for streaming and our token accounting. We can provide an S3 upload endpoint + short-lived creds. Need max file size and expected ingest rate. Default infra: 1x A100 equiv, autoscale disabled for POC.

nina s: Security notes: Beacon requires data minimization proof and an export log. They also asked for KMS-backed encryption and audit logs for every access. We should ask for a redaction whitelist/blacklist and an example of a real row so we can sanity-check patterns.

maria g: They will send a 5k record sample in the next 24h. Their ops said records include nested JSON in a column. We should confirm our ingest parser will flatten or accept nested JSON fields. Also pricing: buyer asked if token usage during POC can be zero-rated; propose a $1.5k credit + negotiated overage.

leo t: Important: POC must demonstrate both accuracy of redaction and inference latency under a small burst. Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Redaction recall >= 97% and precision >= 99% on a 300-row blind set
- Latency: p95 < 400ms for chat completions (50 tokens) at nominal load
- End-to-end throughput: sustain 8 QPS for 10 minutes without errors > 0.5%
- Business value: 70% of 30 golden prompts match expected output per customer rubric

sam k: For nested JSON we can accept JSONL and support a path mapping config. I'll add a simple mapping template to the bucket README. Also will spin up a small Redis cache for prefix reuse to improve latency on repeated prompts.

eng-bot: Provisioning job queued: JOB-POC-8291. Steps: create-s3-bucket, create-temp-iam-role, attach-kms, optional-vpc-peering. ETA: 6 hours if approval flows.

nina s: I must flag SAML for console access — Beacon wants SSO for their engineers to view logs. For a 2-week POC we can offer console read-only via scoped temporary accounts + audit logs, but full SAML integration is an advanced task. Need legal signoff on NDA addendum for sample PHI-like data.

maria g: OK we'll request NDA addendum and the sample schema. Also ask them to mark any "sensitive" fields they want purged vs tokenized. We should give two redaction modes: remove vs pseudonymize.

leo t: Small technical ask: quantization/precision differences can change tokenization and matching for golden prompts. Let's lock model variant (gpt-rlhf-1.0-int8) for POC to keep cost predictable and note in the success doc. If they need fp16 later, we can show delta.

sam k: Noted. I'll set the runtime to use int8 quantized weights and pin to region us-west-2. Also will add a note in the runbook to disable aggressive batching to hit latency SLO.

nina s: sec-bot generated a questionnaire prefill link: https://redwood.internal/sec/prefill/beacon-poc-2026 — includes KMS options and our data retention summary. Please review before sharing.

maria g: Customer asked about evaluation harness for redaction diffs. Idea: run our redactor + theirs (if they provide) and produce a line-level diff CSV + summary metrics. We'll include a simple manual review workflow for the 300 blind rows.

leo t: Action items:
- sam k: create JSONL bucket + README + mapping template (today)
- nina s: request NDA addendum and verify audit log retention (today)
- maria g: send success criteria doc and credit proposal ($1.5k + 25% discount on POC overage) (today)
- eng-bot/sam k: kick JOB-POC-8291 and share creds via secure portal (ETA 6h)

maria g: I'll also schedule a 30-min kickoff with Beacon ops tomorrow 11am PT to walk the ingest requirements and confirm the sample shape.

leo t: One more: record a short eval notebook for their engineers showing how to run the redaction harness and compute the metrics. That reduces back-and-forth during the POC.

sam k: Will add a notebook and a small example script. Quick snippet for mapping config in README:

```
# mapping.json (example)
{
  "payload_path": "$.event.data",
  "fields": {
    "patient_name": "event.data.patient.name",
    "dob": "event.data.patient.dob"
  }
}
```

nina s: Thanks. Reconvene after kickoff to confirm infra complete. If Beacon insists on SAML we escalate to engineering for timeline impacts.

maria g: Thanks team — sending draft success doc and sample request now. :rocket:
